name: ARCTIC
summary: 双手操作可动关节物体的连续观测与三维运动标注。
summaryEn: Continuous observations and 3D motion annotations of bimanual articulated-object manipulation.
scale: About 2.1M multiview images; 8 third-person and 1 egocentric view
scaleZh: 约 210 万张多视角图像；8 个第三人称视角和 1 个第一人称视角
access: Registration through the publisher is required
accessZh: 需按官方流程注册获取数据
license: Consult publisher terms; data license not independently verified
licenseZh: 请核对发布方条款；数据许可尚未独立核实
wmNote: 多视角图像数不等于独立时刻数；人体动作不是机器人控制指令。
wmNoteEn: Multiview image counts are not counts of independent time steps; human movements are not robot control commands.

evidence.locator: Why use ARCTIC; News; consistent motion reconstruction
evidence.statement: The release documents motion-captured dexterous manipulation with synchronized views and SMPL-X, MANO and articulated-object ground truth, supporting consistent motion reconstruction and ordered state trajectories.
